text: The achievement comes just over a week after the three-time Olympic 1500m champion, 31, failed in her bid to become the first woman in history to run a sub-four-minute mile.

Just over a week has passed since the three-time Olympic 1500m champion, aged 31, fell short in her attempt to be the first woman ever to complete a mile in under four minutes, leading to this achievement.
Her next challenge is Sunday's Cotswold Classic, a triathlon event which involves cycling, swimming and running a total of 70.3 miles (113.1km).
She takes on the event's full challenge - a 750m swim, a 20km (12.4-mile) bike ride and a 5km (3.1-mile) push/run - having completed shorter challenges in previous years.
Run on the 4.75-mile (6.8km) Billown Course, the event is marking its 70th year in 2025.
Single homeless individuals are assisted by STFH, and Gordon Pardy, the charity's head of fundraising, expressed their delight in receiving the cheque from Ms. Babb.
